hook.text: An AI agent built this! Minecraft, inside GTA V.

montage.text: Mobs versus the LSPD. Halo's Warthog, in Minecraft. Even a World at War flamethrower!

reveal.text: It's called Universal Modder, and it passed 5,000 GitHub stars in just over a week!

how.text: Point Claude Code, Codex or Gemini at a game you own. It reads the real code, builds the mod, makes the art and sound, and tests it in-game.

catch.text: The catch: the art and sound use fal, which is pay per use, and it refuses online games with anti-cheat. The plugin itself is free and open source.

cta.text: Which game would you mod first? Comment MOD and I'll pin the link.
